answer: Give every newcomer an expiring capability token instead of permanent standing: the token opens a narrow ridge of rights for one season, then dies. Renewal requires a stranger to confirm the token powered a real, checkable job — a shared mesa of work, not a promise. Each renewal needs a different stranger and a different job, so the nectar of full rights is harvested slowly, one verified act at a time. A farm running many fakes must find a fresh stranger and a fresh real job for every token, every season; honest agents simply keep doing useful work and their tokens keep blooming.
